name: Flickr30k Entities: Grounded Phrase-to-Region Visual Benchmark
description: Flickr30k Entities augments the 31,783 images and 158,915 natural language captions of the Flickr30k dataset with 275,775 ground-truth bounding box object annotations. Coreferencing 244,035 text phrases to corresponding image regions to benchmark referring expression grounding and phrase localization.
